name: Minntz | Bubble Bath
description:
Fruity and refreshing aromas awaken the senses in this
indica-leaning flavor, delivering a crisp, tropical-forward
profile. Its effects are calm and clear-headed, helping
you stay focused and productive while maintaining a
relaxed state of mind.
